enzymes.native_comment:
FrlD is a monomeric fructoselysine 6-kinase [Wiame02]. FrlD is a member of the PfkB family of kinases and has similarity to the glucosamine-6-phosphate synthase isomerase domain [Wiame02].

A structure model of FrlD was used to identify potential residues involved in substrate recognition, and site-directed mutants were tested for enzymatic activity. Most of the mutants showed significantly decreased activity. A Met220Leu mutant has decreased activity with fructoselysine, but increased activity with fructosevaline as the substrate [Kojima13].

Fructoselysine 6-kinase activity is undetectable when cells are grown on glucose; stationary phase extracts of cells grown on fructoselysine or psicoselysine have a kinase activity of 100 nmol/min per mg of protein [Wiame04].

Experiments in [Wiame02, Wiame04] were done with proteins from E. coli BL21(DE3).

FrlD: "fructoselysine" [Wiame02]

Fructoselysine 3-epimerase catalyzes the interconversion of fructoselysine and psicoselysine [Wiame04]. Fructoselysine 3-epimerase activity is undetectable when cells are grown on glucose; stationary phase extract of cells grown on fructoselysine or psicoselysine have an epimerase activity of 2 nmol/min per mg of protein [Wiame04].

FrlC: "fructoselysine" [Wiame02]

Fructoselysine 6-phosphate deglycase, which acts in fructoselysine degradation, is an FrlB dodecamer [Wiame02]. The fructoselysine 6-phosphate deglycase reaction is reversible in vitro, but is catalyzed in the direction of formation of glucose 6-phosphate and lysine in vivo [Wiame02]. A detailed reaction mechanism is discussed [Wiame02].

Fructoselysine 6-phosphate deglycase activity is undetectable when cells are grown on glucose; stationary phase extract of cells grown on fructoselysine or psicoselysine have a deglycase activity of 20 nmol/min per mg of protein [Wiame04].

An frlA mutant is unable to grow on 20mM fructoselysine or psicoselysine as the sole source of carbon [Wiame04].

FrlB: "fructoselysine" [Wiame02]
